legacy_side_by_side.evidence: Historic RobotStage.tsx constants (FOLLOWER_OFFSET 0.45, LEADER_OFFSET -0.5). X translations only; base rotations unknown. Step 4 audit: cube A unreachable for the leader (reports/workspace_registration.json).

experimental_shared_table.label: Experimental shared table (arms facing each other)
experimental_shared_table.evidence: Mounting convention of the ALOHA reference model (MuJoCo Menagerie aloha/aloha.xml, BSD-3-Clause, values only, no assets copied): left/base_link pos (-0.469, -0.019, 0.02), right/base_link pos (0.469, -0.019, 0.02) quat (0 0 0 1) = yaw pi. Here leader takes the left mount and follower the right mount. Deviations: the common Y offset -0.019 m and the 0.02 m mounting-plate height are not applied (base_link origin on the table top, z = 0). The reference mounts two vx300s; this studio mounts a wx250s leader, so leader reach is smaller. Not a hardware measurement.
